chunks: And from his words (peace be upon him) to Kumayl ibn Ziyad an-Nakha'i.

key_terms.النَّخَعِيِّ: an-Nakha'i, the tribal nisba of Kumayl
key_terms.كُمَيْلِ بْنِ زِيَادٍ: Kumayl ibn Ziyad, the companion addressed

ai.seo_question: What is the Sermon of Kumayl in Nahj al-Balagha?
ai.summary: This heading introduces the 'Dua Kumayl', a cornerstone of Shia devotional literature traditionally recited on Thursday nights, where Imam Ali (AS) imparts esoteric knowledge of divine attributes and spiritual purification. It serves as a bridge between intellectual understanding (ma'rifah) and practical worship, emphasizing the transformative power of supplication in drawing near to Allah.
